text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? ...Come to think of it, was that 
today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Did you seriously forget?! And here I was, 
all jittery and restless for a whole 
month!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell are *you* getting all 
fidgety...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because it's Shakur's once-a-year, 
super-duper special day! So I came up with 
my own happy plan for it♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A "happy plan", huh... It's probably just 
eating ramen or looking for four-leaf 
clovers or something like that, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Nope~ Here, I sent it to your phone, take 
a look!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start with the hip-hop 
concert Shakur likes! YO! YO! Let's GO!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, I'll go, so cut that out.
